lastCompletedStory.title: Make renderStateFile/clearActive preserve the loop phase

nextStoryContext: renderStateFile now accepts an opt-in `cwd` field: when `phase` is absent AND `cwd` is given, it read-modify-writes the phase from the CURRENT on-disk state file (readCurrentPhase helper, next.ts) instead of deriving from the legacy `active` flag; a nonexistent/unparseable/phase-less file still defaults to `idle`. `cwd` is opt-in on purpose -- every pre-existing caller that omits both `phase` and `cwd` (runNext's two branches, makeOnProgress in host.ts) is UNCHANGED and still uses the legacy active-derived fallback. makeClearActive (sidecar.ts) is the only production writer updated to pass `cwd`, which is the actual Defect 3 fix: it no longer collapses phase to idle. The CAM-191 auto-ship reorder workaround in loop.ts (auto-ship positioned AFTER clearActive) was retired as a consequence: auto-ship now runs BEFORE clearActive again (its natural position), since clearActive no longer clobbers phase regardless of order. ADR 0013 was annotated (not rewritten) as partially superseded; the CAM-191 patterns.md bullet was marked [resolved 2026-07] and a new durable bullet documents the RMW-over-a-boolean-flag pattern. If a future story wants makeOnProgress (host.ts) or runNext to also stop force-deriving phase from `active`, that is a SEPARATE change (out of scope here per this story's notes, which named only next.ts + sidecar.ts) -- audit call sites carefully before adding `cwd` elsewhere, since e.g. runNext's active:true branches intentionally want to flip to 'implementing' regardless of prior on-disk phase (that IS cam next's job), so blindly adding cwd there would break the trigger.
